title: config-explain
description: Where every effective setting of a module comes from: the layers consulted and, per key, the winning layer, file and line and the lower values it overrides. Output of `aicore config explain <module> --json`; produced by `ResolvedConfig.explain_json`.

module.description: Module id whose configuration is explained.

project.description: Project root the project layer was read from, or null when no project was given.

config_file_version.description: Version of the config file format the explaining swissknifeman reads.

layers.description: Layers from the lowest to the highest priority.

entries.description: One entry per key that has a value, in schema order.

name.description: Layer name: defaults, machine, project, env, invocation, flags or the name of an extra layer.

file.description: File the layer is read from, or null when it has none.

present.description: True when the layer contributed anything; a file that does not exist or is empty is not present.

setting.description: A value that a layer gave to a key and a higher layer overrode.

file.description: File of the layer, or null.

line.description: 1-based line of the key in the file, or null when unknown.

source.description: Environment variable name, `--config`, `flag`, extra layer name, `_unset` for a reset or `_append` for an extension; null for files and defaults.

value.description: The value the layer gave: a JSON scalar or array; null for a reset (`_unset`). A secret key shows its reference, never the secret.

entry.description: The effective value of one key and its origin.

key.description: Dotted key relative to the module section.

value.description: The effective value: a JSON scalar or array. A secret key shows its reference, never the secret.

layer.description: Layer the effective value comes from.

file.description: File of that layer, or null.

line.description: 1-based line of the key in the file, or null when unknown.

source.description: Environment variable name, `--config`, `flag`, extra layer name or `_append`; null for files and defaults.

secret.description: True when the key holds a secret reference.

default.description: The default of the schema; absent when the key has none.

overridden.description: Lower values this one overrides, nearest layer first.
